dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: 喂，你有冇時間？你好似好擔心咁。
dialogue.en: Hi, do you have a minute? You look worried.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 有。我想請下個星期五放假。
dialogue.en: Yes. I would like to ask for a day off next Friday.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 有少少。我要去另一個城市參加表哥嘅婚禮。
dialogue.en: A little. I must go to my cousin's wedding in another city.

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: 我明白。嗰日邊個可以接手你嘅工作？
dialogue.en: I see. Who can cover your work that day?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 我同事可以代替我，而且我會預先將一切準備好。
dialogue.en: My colleague can replace me, and I will prepare everything in advance.

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.en: That is helpful. Have you asked her already?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 重未。我想先同你傾下，當係幫個忙。
dialogue.en: Not yet. I wanted to speak with you first, as a favor.

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: 明白。你可以放假，不過走之前要寫完份報告。
dialogue.en: I understand. You may take the day, but finish the report before you leave.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Of course, thank you for being so understanding.

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: 唔使客氣。祝你婚禮玩得開心！

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 多謝晒。我會帶一件蛋糕俾你。
dialogue.en: Thank you very much. I will bring you some cake.
